scripts.setup: npm install && uv sync && cd web && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd api && uv run uvicorn server:app --port 8765 --env-file ../.env
scripts.test:local: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8765 API_KEY="$API_KEY" DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL" uv run python test/e2e.py
